21	from freige.data.docred_processor import DocREDProcessor

23	SYSTEM_PROMPT = (
24	    "You are an information extraction model. Given a document with numbered sentences "
25	    "and a list of entities, extract all relation triples. For each triple, provide the "
26	    "head entity, relation type, tail entity, and the sentence IDs that serve as evidence. "
27	    "Output as a JSON list."

40	def load_model():
41	    print("Loading tokenizer...")

43	        BASE_MODEL, trust_remote_code=True, padding_side="left",
44	    )
45	    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
46	        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token
47	
48	    print("Loading model (4-bit)...")
49	    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
50	        BASE_MODEL,
51	        trust_remote_code=True,
52	        attn_implementation="sdpa",
53	        device_map="auto",
54	        quantization_config=BitsAndBytesConfig(
55	            load_in_4bit=True,
56	            bnb_4bit_compute_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
57	            bnb_4bit_quant_type="nf4",
58	            bnb_4bit_use_double_quant=True,
59	        ),

63	    model = PeftModel.from_pretrained(model, SFT_ADAPTER)

70	def select_samples(data_dir, tokenizer, n=5):
71	    """选择不同复杂度的文档样本。"""
72	    processor = DocREDProcessor(data_dir=data_dir)
73	    samples = processor.process("train")
74	    groups = processor.group_by_document(samples)
75	
76	    doc_info = []
77	    for doc_id, doc_samples in groups.items():
78	        sft = processor.format_sft_sample(doc_samples)
79	        messages = [
80	            {"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM_PROMPT},
81	            {"role": "user", "content": f"{sft['instruction']}\n\n{sft['input']}"},
82	        ]
83	        prompt = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
84	            messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True, enable_thinking=False,
85	        )
86	        gold_triples = json.loads(sft["output"])
87	        n_sents = len(doc_samples[0].sents)
88	        doc_info.append({
89	            "doc_id": doc_id,
90	            "prompt": prompt,
91	            "gold_triples": gold_triples,
92	            "gold_json": sft["output"],
93	            "n_triples": len(gold_triples),
94	            "n_sents": n_sents,
95	        })
96	
97	    doc_info.sort(key=lambda x: x["n_triples"])
98	    total = len(doc_info)
99	    indices = [
100	        int(total * 0.1),
101	        int(total * 0.3),
102	        int(total * 0.5),
103	        int(total * 0.7),
104	        int(total * 0.9),
105	    ]
106	    selected = [doc_info[i] for i in indices[:n]]
107	    print(f"Selected {len(selected)} samples: " +
108	          ", ".join(f"{s['doc_id']}({s['n_triples']}t,{s['n_sents']}s)" for s in selected))
109	    return selected
110	
111	
112	def parse_json_output(text):
113	    try:
114	        return json.loads(text)
115	    except json.JSONDecodeError:
116	        start = text.find("[")
117	        end = text.rfind("]") + 1
118	        if start >= 0 and end > start:
119	            try:
120	                return json.loads(text[start:end])
121	            except json.JSONDecodeError:
122	                return []
123	    return []
124	
125	
126	def format_reward(text):
127	    parsed = parse_json_output(text)
128	    if not isinstance(parsed, list):
129	        return 0.0
130	    if not parsed:
131	        return 0.1
132	    valid = 0
133	    for item in parsed:
134	        if (isinstance(item, dict) and "head" in item
135	                and "relation" in item and "tail" in item
136	                and "evidence" in item
137	                and isinstance(item["evidence"], list)):
138	            valid += 1
139	    return valid / len(parsed)
140	
141	
142	def f1_reward(text, gold_triples):
143	    pred = parse_json_output(text)
144	    gold_set = set()
145	    for g in gold_triples:
146	        gold_set.add((
147	            g.get("head", "").lower().strip(),
148	            g.get("relation", "").lower().strip(),
149	            g.get("tail", "").lower().strip(),
150	        ))
151	    pred_set = set()
152	    for p in pred:
153	        if isinstance(p, dict):
154	            pred_set.add((
155	                str(p.get("head") or "").lower().strip(),
156	                str(p.get("relation") or "").lower().strip(),
157	                str(p.get("tail") or "").lower().strip(),
158	            ))
159	    if not gold_set:
160	        return 1.0 if not pred_set else 0.0
161	    tp = len(pred_set & gold_set)
162	    prec = tp / len(pred_set) if pred_set else 0.0
163	    rec = tp / len(gold_set) if gold_set else 0.0
164	    return 2 * prec * rec / (prec + rec) if (prec + rec) > 0 else 0.0
165	
166	
167	def triple_set_from_text(text):
168	    parsed = parse_json_output(text)
169	    triples = set()
170	    for p in parsed:
171	        if isinstance(p, dict):
172	            triples.add((
173	                str(p.get("head") or "").lower().strip(),
174	                str(p.get("relation") or "").lower().strip(),
175	                str(p.get("tail") or "").lower().strip(),
176	            ))
177	    return triples
178	
179	
180	def pairwise_jaccard(outputs):
181	    """计算所有输出对之间的 Jaccard 相似度。"""
182	    triple_sets = [triple_set_from_text(o) for o in outputs]
183	    similarities = []
184	    for i, j in itertools.combinations(range(len(triple_sets)), 2):
185	        a, b = triple_sets[i], triple_sets[j]
186	        if not a and not b:
187	            similarities.append(1.0)
188	        elif not a or not b:
189	            similarities.append(0.0)
190	        else:
191	            inter = len(a & b)
192	            union = len(a | b)
193	            similarities.append(inter / union if union > 0 else 0.0)
194	    return similarities
195	
196	
197	def unique_triple_sets(outputs):
198	    """统计不同的 triple set 数量。"""
199	    seen = set()
200	    for o in outputs:
201	        ts = triple_set_from_text(o)
202	        seen.add(frozenset(ts))
203	    return len(seen)

206	@torch.no_grad()
207	def generate_n(model, tokenizer, prompt, n, temperature):
208	    """对单个 prompt 生成 n 个输出。逐个生成避免 OOM。"""
209	    results = []
210	    inputs = tokenizer(prompt, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True, max_length=4096).to(model.device)
211	    for i in range(n):

221	        gen_ids = output[0, input_len:]
222	        text = tokenizer.decode(gen_ids, skip_special_tokens=True)
223	        results.append(text)
224	        print(f"    gen {i+1}/{n}: {len(gen_ids)} tokens, format={format_reward(text):.2f}")

228	def compute_stats(values):
229	    if not values:
230	        return {"mean": 0, "std": 0, "min": 0, "max": 0}
231	    import statistics
232	    return {
233	        "mean": round(statistics.mean(values), 4),
234	        "std": round(statistics.stdev(values), 4) if len(values) > 1 else 0,
235	        "min": round(min(values), 4),

240	def main():
241	    model, tokenizer = load_model()
242	    samples = select_samples(DATA_DIR, tokenizer, n=NUM_SAMPLES)
243	
244	    all_results = []
245	
246	    for si, sample in enumerate(samples):
247	        doc_id = sample["doc_id"]
248	        gold = sample["gold_triples"]
249	        print(f"\n{'='*60}")
250	        print(f"[{si+1}/{len(samples)}] doc={doc_id}, gold_triples={sample['n_triples']}, sents={sample['n_sents']}")
251	
252	        doc_result = {"doc_id": doc_id, "n_gold": sample["n_triples"], "n_sents": sample["n_sents"]}
253	
254	        for temp in TEMPERATURES:
255	            print(f"\n  temperature={temp}")
256	            t0 = time.time()
257	            outputs = generate_n(model, tokenizer, sample["prompt"], NUM_GENERATIONS, temp)
258	            elapsed = time.time() - t0

260	            f1_scores = [f1_reward(o, gold) for o in outputs]
261	            fmt_scores = [format_reward(o) for o in outputs]
262	            n_triples_per_output = [len(parse_json_output(o)) for o in outputs]
263	            jaccard_sims = pairwise_jaccard(outputs)
264	            n_unique = unique_triple_sets(outputs)
265	            n_format_ok = sum(1 for s in fmt_scores if s >= 0.9)
266	            n_nonempty = sum(1 for o in outputs if len(parse_json_output(o)) > 0)
267	
268	            temp_result = {
269	                "temperature": temp,
270	                "elapsed_sec": round(elapsed, 1),
271	                "f1": compute_stats(f1_scores),
272	                "format": compute_stats(fmt_scores),
273	                "n_triples": compute_stats([float(x) for x in n_triples_per_output]),
274	                "jaccard_sim": compute_stats(jaccard_sims),
275	                "n_unique_sets": n_unique,
276	                "n_format_ok": n_format_ok,
277	                "n_nonempty": n_nonempty,
278	                "raw_f1_scores": f1_scores,
279	                "raw_fmt_scores": fmt_scores,

284	            print(f"  f1:  mean={temp_result['f1']['mean']:.3f} std={temp_result['f1']['std']:.3f} "
285	                  f"[{temp_result['f1']['min']:.3f}, {temp_result['f1']['max']:.3f}]")
286	            print(f"  fmt: mean={temp_result['format']['mean']:.3f}, ok={n_format_ok}/{NUM_GENERATIONS}")
287	            print(f"  jaccard: mean={temp_result['jaccard_sim']['mean']:.3f} std={temp_result['jaccard_sim']['std']:.3f}")
288	            print(f"  unique triple-sets: {n_unique}/{NUM_GENERATIONS}")
289	            print(f"  elapsed: {elapsed:.1f}s")

291	        all_results.append(doc_result)

293	    os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
294	
295	    # Save raw JSON
296	    json_path = Path(OUTPUT_DIR) / "diversity_probe_raw.json"
297	    with open(json_path, "w") as f:

"""Diversity Probe: 验证 SFT 模型在不同 temperature 下的输出多样性。

用法:
  CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 python /root/autodl-tmp/scripts/diversity_probe.py
"""

import json
import itertools
import os
import sys
import time
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import torch
from peft import PeftModel
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer, BitsAndBytesConfig

sys.path.insert(0, "/root/autodl-tmp")

from freige.data.docred_processor import DocREDProcessor

SYSTEM_PROMPT = (
    "You are an information extraction model. Given a document with numbered sentences "
    "and a list of entities, extract all relation triples. For each triple, provide the "
    "head entity, relation type, tail entity, and the sentence IDs that serve as evidence. "
    "Output as a JSON list."
)

BASE_MODEL = "/root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen3-4B"
SFT_ADAPTER = "/root/autodl-tmp/sft_output"
DATA_DIR = "/root/autodl-tmp/data/docred"
OUTPUT_DIR = "/root/autodl-tmp/artifacts"
NUM_GENERATIONS = 8
TEMPERATURES = [0.7, 1.0]
MAX_NEW_TOKENS = 2048
NUM_SAMPLES = 5


def load_model():
    print("Loading tokenizer...")
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(
        BASE_MODEL, trust_remote_code=True, padding_side="left",
    )
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

    print("Loading model (4-bit)...")
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        BASE_MODEL,
        trust_remote_code=True,
        attn_implementation="sdpa",
        device_map="auto",
        quantization_config=BitsAndBytesConfig(
            load_in_4bit=True,
            bnb_4bit_compute_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
            bnb_4bit_quant_type="nf4",
            bnb_4bit_use_double_quant=True,
        ),
    )

    print("Loading & merging SFT adapter...")
    model = PeftModel.from_pretrained(model, SFT_ADAPTER)
    model = model.merge_and_unload()
    model.eval()
    print("Model ready.")
    return model, tokenizer


def select_samples(data_dir, tokenizer, n=5):
    """选择不同复杂度的文档样本。"""
    processor = DocREDProcessor(data_dir=data_dir)
    samples = processor.process("train")
    groups = processor.group_by_document(samples)

    doc_info = []
    for doc_id, doc_samples in groups.items():
        sft = processor.format_sft_sample(doc_samples)
        messages = [
            {"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM_PROMPT},
            {"role": "user", "content": f"{sft['instruction']}\n\n{sft['input']}"},
        ]
        prompt = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
            messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True, enable_thinking=False,
        )
        gold_triples = json.loads(sft["output"])
        n_sents = len(doc_samples[0].sents)
        doc_info.append({
            "doc_id": doc_id,
            "prompt": prompt,
            "gold_triples": gold_triples,
            "gold_json": sft["output"],
            "n_triples": len(gold_triples),
            "n_sents": n_sents,
        })

    doc_info.sort(key=lambda x: x["n_triples"])
    total = len(doc_info)
    indices = [
        int(total * 0.1),
        int(total * 0.3),
        int(total * 0.5),
        int(total * 0.7),
        int(total * 0.9),
    ]
    selected = [doc_info[i] for i in indices[:n]]
    print(f"Selected {len(selected)} samples: " +
          ", ".join(f"{s['doc_id']}({s['n_triples']}t,{s['n_sents']}s)" for s in selected))
    return selected


def parse_json_output(text):
    try:
        return json.loads(text)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        start = text.find("[")
        end = text.rfind("]") + 1
        if start >= 0 and end > start:
            try:
                return json.loads(text[start:end])
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                return []
    return []


def format_reward(text):
    parsed = parse_json_output(text)
    if not isinstance(parsed, list):
        return 0.0
    if not parsed:
        return 0.1
    valid = 0
    for item in parsed:
        if (isinstance(item, dict) and "head" in item
                and "relation" in item and "tail" in item
                and "evidence" in item
                and isinstance(item["evidence"], list)):
            valid += 1
    return valid / len(parsed)


def f1_reward(text, gold_triples):
    pred = parse_json_output(text)
    gold_set = set()
    for g in gold_triples:
        gold_set.add((
            g.get("head", "").lower().strip(),
            g.get("relation", "").lower().strip(),
            g.get("tail", "").lower().strip(),
        ))
    pred_set = set()
    for p in pred:
        if isinstance(p, dict):
            pred_set.add((
                str(p.get("head") or "").lower().strip(),
                str(p.get("relation") or "").lower().strip(),
                str(p.get("tail") or "").lower().strip(),
            ))
    if not gold_set:
        return 1.0 if not pred_set else 0.0
    tp = len(pred_set & gold_set)
    prec = tp / len(pred_set) if pred_set else 0.0
    rec = tp / len(gold_set) if gold_set else 0.0
    return 2 * prec * rec / (prec + rec) if (prec + rec) > 0 else 0.0


def triple_set_from_text(text):
    parsed = parse_json_output(text)
    triples = set()
    for p in parsed:
        if isinstance(p, dict):
            triples.add((
                str(p.get("head") or "").lower().strip(),
                str(p.get("relation") or "").lower().strip(),
                str(p.get("tail") or "").lower().strip(),
            ))
    return triples


def pairwise_jaccard(outputs):
    """计算所有输出对之间的 Jaccard 相似度。"""
    triple_sets = [triple_set_from_text(o) for o in outputs]
    similarities = []
    for i, j in itertools.combinations(range(len(triple_sets)), 2):
        a, b = triple_sets[i], triple_sets[j]
        if not a and not b:
            similarities.append(1.0)
        elif not a or not b:
            similarities.append(0.0)
        else:
            inter = len(a & b)
            union = len(a | b)
            similarities.append(inter / union if union > 0 else 0.0)
    return similarities


def unique_triple_sets(outputs):
    """统计不同的 triple set 数量。"""
    seen = set()
    for o in outputs:
        ts = triple_set_from_text(o)
        seen.add(frozenset(ts))
    return len(seen)


@torch.no_grad()
def generate_n(model, tokenizer, prompt, n, temperature):
    """对单个 prompt 生成 n 个输出。逐个生成避免 OOM。"""
    results = []
    inputs = tokenizer(prompt, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True, max_length=4096).to(model.device)
    for i in range(n):
        output = model.generate(
            **inputs,
            max_new_tokens=MAX_NEW_TOKENS,
            do_sample=True,
            temperature=temperature,
            top_p=0.9,
            pad_token_id=tokenizer.pad_token_id,
        )
        input_len = inputs["input_ids"].shape[1]
        gen_ids = output[0, input_len:]
        text = tokenizer.decode(gen_ids, skip_special_tokens=True)
        results.append(text)
        print(f"    gen {i+1}/{n}: {len(gen_ids)} tokens, format={format_reward(text):.2f}")
    return results


def compute_stats(values):
    if not values:
        return {"mean": 0, "std": 0, "min": 0, "max": 0}
    import statistics
    return {
        "mean": round(statistics.mean(values), 4),
        "std": round(statistics.stdev(values), 4) if len(values) > 1 else 0,
        "min": round(min(values), 4),
        "max": round(max(values), 4),
    }


def main():
    model, tokenizer = load_model()
    samples = select_samples(DATA_DIR, tokenizer, n=NUM_SAMPLES)

    all_results = []

    for si, sample in enumerate(samples):
        doc_id = sample["doc_id"]
        gold = sample["gold_triples"]
        print(f"\n{'='*60}")
        print(f"[{si+1}/{len(samples)}] doc={doc_id}, gold_triples={sample['n_triples']}, sents={sample['n_sents']}")

        doc_result = {"doc_id": doc_id, "n_gold": sample["n_triples"], "n_sents": sample["n_sents"]}

        for temp in TEMPERATURES:
            print(f"\n  temperature={temp}")
            t0 = time.time()
            outputs = generate_n(model, tokenizer, sample["prompt"], NUM_GENERATIONS, temp)
            elapsed = time.time() - t0

            f1_scores = [f1_reward(o, gold) for o in outputs]
            fmt_scores = [format_reward(o) for o in outputs]
            n_triples_per_output = [len(parse_json_output(o)) for o in outputs]
            jaccard_sims = pairwise_jaccard(outputs)
            n_unique = unique_triple_sets(outputs)
            n_format_ok = sum(1 for s in fmt_scores if s >= 0.9)
            n_nonempty = sum(1 for o in outputs if len(parse_json_output(o)) > 0)

            temp_result = {
                "temperature": temp,
                "elapsed_sec": round(elapsed, 1),
                "f1": compute_stats(f1_scores),
                "format": compute_stats(fmt_scores),
                "n_triples": compute_stats([float(x) for x in n_triples_per_output]),
                "jaccard_sim": compute_stats(jaccard_sims),
                "n_unique_sets": n_unique,
                "n_format_ok": n_format_ok,
                "n_nonempty": n_nonempty,
                "raw_f1_scores": f1_scores,
                "raw_fmt_scores": fmt_scores,
                "raw_n_triples": n_triples_per_output,
            }
            doc_result[f"temp_{temp}"] = temp_result

            print(f"  f1:  mean={temp_result['f1']['mean']:.3f} std={temp_result['f1']['std']:.3f} "
                  f"[{temp_result['f1']['min']:.3f}, {temp_result['f1']['max']:.3f}]")
            print(f"  fmt: mean={temp_result['format']['mean']:.3f}, ok={n_format_ok}/{NUM_GENERATIONS}")
            print(f"  jaccard: mean={temp_result['jaccard_sim']['mean']:.3f} std={temp_result['jaccard_sim']['std']:.3f}")
            print(f"  unique triple-sets: {n_unique}/{NUM_GENERATIONS}")
            print(f"  elapsed: {elapsed:.1f}s")

        all_results.append(doc_result)

    os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

    # Save raw JSON
    json_path = Path(OUTPUT_DIR) / "diversity_probe_raw.json"
    with open(json_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(all_results, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
    print(f"\nRaw results saved to {json_path}")

    # Generate markdown report
    report = generate_report(all_results)
    md_path = Path(OUTPUT_DIR) / "diversity_probe_results.md"
    with open(md_path, "w") as f:
        f.write(report)
    print(f"Report saved to {md_path}")


def generate_report(results):
    lines = ["# SFT 模型输出多样性探测 (Diversity Probe)", ""]
    lines.append(f"- Base model: `Qwen3-4B`")
    lines.append(f"- Adapter: `sft_output` (QLoRA)")
    lines.append(f"- N generations per sample: {NUM_GENERATIONS}")
    lines.append(f"- Temperatures: {TEMPERATURES}")
    lines.append(f"- Samples: {len(results)}")
    lines.append("")

    for temp in TEMPERATURES:
        key = f"temp_{temp}"
        lines.append(f"## Temperature = {temp}")
        lines.append("")

        # Per-sample table
        lines.append("| Doc ID | #Gold | F1 mean±std | F1 range | Fmt OK | Jaccard mean±std | Unique Sets |")
        lines.append("|--------|-------|-------------|----------|--------|------------------|-------------|")
        for r in results:
            t = r[key]
            lines.append(
                f"| {r['doc_id'][:25]} | {r['n_gold']} | "
                f"{t['f1']['mean']:.3f}±{t['f1']['std']:.3f} | "
                f"[{t['f1']['min']:.3f}, {t['f1']['max']:.3f}] | "
                f"{t['n_format_ok']}/{NUM_GENERATIONS} | "
                f"{t['jaccard_sim']['mean']:.3f}±{t['jaccard_sim']['std']:.3f} | "
                f"{t['n_unique_sets']}/{NUM_GENERATIONS} |"
            )
        lines.append("")

        # Aggregate stats
        all_f1_means = [r[key]["f1"]["mean"] for r in results]
        all_f1_stds = [r[key]["f1"]["std"] for r in results]
        all_jaccard_means = [r[key]["jaccard_sim"]["mean"] for r in results]
        all_unique = [r[key]["n_unique_sets"] for r in results]
        all_fmt_ok = [r[key]["n_format_ok"] for r in results]

        import statistics
        lines.append(f"**Aggregate (n={len(results)} docs):**")
        lines.append(f"- F1 mean across docs: {statistics.mean(all_f1_means):.3f}")
        lines.append(f"- F1 std across docs (diversity signal): {statistics.mean(all_f1_stds):.3f}")
        lines.append(f"- Jaccard similarity (lower = more diverse): {statistics.mean(all_jaccard_means):.3f}")
        lines.append(f"- Avg unique triple-sets: {statistics.mean(all_unique):.1f}/{NUM_GENERATIONS}")
        lines.append(f"- Format compliance: {statistics.mean(all_fmt_ok):.1f}/{NUM_GENERATIONS}")
        lines.append("")

    # Comparison
    lines.append("## Temperature 对比")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("| Metric | T=0.7 | T=1.0 | Delta |")
    lines.append("|--------|-------|-------|-------|")

    import statistics
    for metric_name, extractor in [
        ("F1 mean", lambda r, k: r[k]["f1"]["mean"]),
        ("F1 std (diversity)", lambda r, k: r[k]["f1"]["std"]),
        ("Jaccard sim", lambda r, k: r[k]["jaccard_sim"]["mean"]),
        ("Unique sets", lambda r, k: r[k]["n_unique_sets"]),
        ("Format OK", lambda r, k: r[k]["n_format_ok"]),
    ]:
        v07 = statistics.mean([extractor(r, "temp_0.7") for r in results])
        v10 = statistics.mean([extractor(r, "temp_1.0") for r in results])
        delta = v10 - v07
        lines.append(f"| {metric_name} | {v07:.3f} | {v10:.3f} | {delta:+.3f} |")
    lines.append("")

    # Conclusion
    lines.append("## 结论与建议")
    lines.append("")

    avg_jaccard_07 = statistics.mean([r["temp_0.7"]["jaccard_sim"]["mean"] for r in results])
    avg_jaccard_10 = statistics.mean([r["temp_1.0"]["jaccard_sim"]["mean"] for r in results])
    avg_unique_07 = statistics.mean([r["temp_0.7"]["n_unique_sets"] for r in results])
    avg_unique_10 = statistics.mean([r["temp_1.0"]["n_unique_sets"] for r in results])
    avg_fmt_07 = statistics.mean([r["temp_0.7"]["n_format_ok"] for r in results])
    avg_fmt_10 = statistics.mean([r["temp_1.0"]["n_format_ok"] for r in results])

    if avg_unique_07 >= 5:
        lines.append(f"- **T=0.7 多样性充足** (avg {avg_unique_07:.1f}/{NUM_GENERATIONS} unique sets, "
                     f"jaccard={avg_jaccard_07:.3f}), RSFT 在 T=0.7 下可行。")
    elif avg_unique_10 >= 5:
        lines.append(f"- T=0.7 多样性不足 ({avg_unique_07:.1f} unique sets)。"
                     f"**T=1.0 多样性可接受** ({avg_unique_10:.1f} unique sets), "
                     f"建议用 T=1.0 做 RSFT。")
    else:
        lines.append(f"- **两种 temperature 多样性均不足** (T=0.7: {avg_unique_07:.1f}, T=1.0: {avg_unique_10:.1f} unique sets)。")
        lines.append("- 建议替代方案：")
        lines.append("  1. 提高 temperature 至 1.2-1.5")
        lines.append("  2. 降低 top_p 至 0.8 + 更高 temperature")
        lines.append("  3. 启用 dropout (train mode) 增加随机性")
